t: Long-lasting protection from corrosion and rust with MOS2. Can be used on all ferrous metals. Loosens rust-to-metal bonds and frees seized or rusted metal parts such as screws, nuts and bolts. Ideal for cycle maintenance as well as cleaning brake linkages, bowden cables and chains. Can also be used to stop squeaking and creaking noises or to grease sliding surfaces. Suitable for use in servicing, repairs, maintenance and production.
b: Suitable for Use on Ferrous Metals
Can be Used on Rusted Applications
